items.title: CVS pharmacists take step towards strike over staffing, burnout
items.summary: Unionized CVS pharmacists in three states greenlit a strike sanction last week as they seek better staffing levels and a seat at the table on CVS’ pharmacy decisions.

items.title: UNH Leads Its Peer Group. You Pay For That
items.summary: In the health insurance arena, one company is both the undisputed leader and the most expensive ticket, forcing investors to decide if paying up for quality is a winning strategy.

items.title: Another Hospital System Just Went Out-of-Network Mid-Year. Medicare Advantage Members Have Fewer Protections Than They May Assume.
items.summary: When a hospital walks out of a Medicare Advantage contract, the member left behind faces a narrower set of protections and a much higher potential bill than most people realize until the letter arrives.

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Is Down 8.6% After Raising 2026 Guidance And Expanding GLP-1 Tie-Up With Lilly – Has The Bull Case Changed?

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Turn More Constructive
items.summary: The fair value estimate for CVS Health has shifted from US$111.92 to US$114.88, signaling a modest reset in where analysts think the stock could be worth over time. This change lines up with recent research that leans constructive on CVS Health ahead of upcoming earnings, while still calling out execution and policy risks that could affect how closely the stock trades to that mark.
